defects: Adds an unnecessary [Monoid M] typeclass hypothesis not present in the gold statement. The underlying Mathlib lemma (MonoidAlgebra.addHom_ext) holds for M an arbitrary type (only [Semiring R] and [AddZeroClass N] are needed, since MonoidAlgebra R M is just Finsupp M R and the statement is purely additive), so requiring M to be a Monoid strictly restricts generality compared to the gold statement.
